# AMC Paper

<!-- Generated by tools/build-styles.mjs from style.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Universal Theme style** · light · built on vita · APEX 23.1+ · v1.0.0

An editorial style for reports and document-heavy apps: near-white paper, ink-black text, one strong ink-blue accent, serif headings and hairline rules instead of boxes.

## Install

- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x:** Shared Components > Export/Import > Import `dist/legacy/amc_style_paper.sql`
  (Component Export) into an app on Universal Theme. It adds the style to Theme 42 and uploads
  `amc-styles/amc-style-paper.css` as a Static Application File. Then pick it in Theme Roller or
  Shared Components > Themes > Universal Theme > Styles (Set as Current), or let users pick it when
  Customization is enabled.
- **APEX 26.1+ (APEXlang):** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/themes/universal-theme/styles/amc-paper.apx` and the static file, merge
  `dist/apexlang/static-files.snippet.apx`, and set `style.currentThemeStyle` in `theme.apx` to
  `@amc-paper` if it should be the default. Then run the apexlang gates.

Light style built on Vita for reports and document-heavy apps. The page is near-white paper with ink-black text; the only accent is a strong ink blue (WCAG AA with white text) used for hot buttons, links, the current menu entry and focus; red is kept for danger only, so a hot button never reads as destructive. Regions drop their boxes: no fill change, no shadow, square corners and a solid ink rule on top, with hairline rules between rows. Page and region titles use the system serif stack (Georgia, Times New Roman); body text stays on the system sans stack for dense data. The header is paper with a double rule like a masthead. Header and navigation refinements target Universal Theme classes and should be checked on a live page.
